key.name: engine
key.description: Which engine's results page is rendered in the overview. DuckDuckGo's HTML endpoint renders reliably; Google answers many networks (VPN exits in particular) with its "unusual traffic" check, which is reported rather than worked around.

key.name: link-mode
key.description:
'contained' follows the link inside the overview's page and shows a back control carrying how many pages you have followed; middle-click or Ctrl+click still opens a link in the browser. 'browser' hands every link to the default browser and closes the overview. Enter on the section always opens what you are looking at in the browser.
Contained is not a browser: no forward, no address bar, no tabs. Anything the view cannot display — a download, a PDF — goes to the real browser whichever mode this is set to.

key.name: section-visibility
key.summary: When the web results section is shown in the overview
key.description: 'always' shows the section for every search. 'no-other-results' shows it only when no application, file or other provider matched; your browser's own "Search online" entry answers every query, so it does not count as a match. The page is rendered either way, so showing it is instant. 'never' keeps the extension out of the overview entirely, for someone who only wants the search window.

key.name: section-placement
key.summary: Where the section sits among the search results
key.description:
'top' pins the section above every other one. 'top-when-alone' moves it up only when nothing else matched (the browser's "Search online" entry aside), so a real app or file match is never pushed down the list. 'default' leaves it where GNOME Shell puts it.
This moves the section, not the keyboard selection: GNOME picks what Enter activates by provider registration order, so with another section showing, Enter still goes to that one.

key.name: search-window
key.summary: Open a search window with a keyboard shortcut
key.description: A shortcut that works anywhere opens a search box over whatever you are doing, with the results page under it as you type. Escape, a click outside it, or the shortcut again closes it. Independent of section-visibility: either, both or neither can be on.

key.name: search-window-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the search window
key.description: Read by the window manager directly, so a change takes effect at once. An empty list leaves the window with no shortcut.
